security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when shadow stack instructions (sspush, sspopchk, ssrdp, ssamoswap, c.sspush, c.sspopchk) are decoded and the implementation checks only the OR of menvcfg.SSE, henvcfg.SSE, and senvcfg.SSE as a single combined enable signal (e.g., any_sse_en = menvcfg.SSE | henvcfg.SSE | senvcfg.SSE) instead of performing the two-stage check: (1) gate on the mode-specific SSE bit to raise IllegalInstruction/VirtualInstruction for the current privilege level, then (2) check any SSE bit for the operation body. Specifically, in VS/VU mode when menvcfg.SSE=1 but henvcfg.SSE=0, or in VU mode when senvcfg.SSE=0, or in U-mode when menvcfg.SSE=1 but senvcfg.SSE=0, a single-combined-check implementation would execute shadow stack operations that the spec requires to trap with VirtualInstruction or IllegalInstruction.
security_spec.summary: Zicfiss shadow stack instruction SSE gating requires mode-specific two-stage checking (illegal check per-mode then any-SSE OR for execution); implementing as a single combined OR-gate of all three SSE bits enables privilege escape where guest/hypervisor-disabled shadow stack operations execute incorrectly

findings.finding: SSE field is defined as RO(3) hardwired to 0 in the abstract base class EnvCfg, which is inherited by MEnvCfg, HEnvCfg, and SEnvCfg. None of the derived classes override SSE to make it RW. The SSE field is never read anywhere in the RTL. Zicfiss is not implemented.
findings.snippet: val SSE = RO(3).withReset(0.U).withDescription("Enable the Zicfiss shadow-stack extension below M-mode.")

spec_citations.excerpt: Attempts to access the ssp CSR may result in either an illegal-instruction exception or a virtual-instruction exception, contingent upon the state of the envcfg[sse] fields. ... If the privilege mode is less than M and menvcfg[sse] is 0, an illegal-instruction exception is raised.

findings.finding: MEnvCfg extends EnvCfg but only overrides STCE, PBMTE, and DTE to be RW. SSE remains RO(3)=0 from the base class. No SSE gate logic exists in menvcfg CSR module instantiation. Zicfiss is not implemented.

spec_citations.excerpt: The term xSSE is used to determine if backward-edge CFI using shadow stacks ... is enabled at a privilege mode. When S-mode is implemented: S or HS => menvcfg[sse]; VS => henvcfg.[sse]; U or VU => senvcfg[sse]

findings.finding: HEnvCfg extends EnvCfg but only overrides STCE, PBMTE, and DTE to be RW. SSE remains RO(3)=0. The henvcfg CSR module has gates for STCE/PBMTE/DTE against menvcfg but no SSE gate. Zicfiss is not implemented.

spec_citations.excerpt: Otherwise, if in VS-mode and henvcfg[sse] is 0, a virtual-instruction exception is raised. Otherwise, if in VU-mode and either henvcfg[sse] or senvcfg[sse] is 0, a virtual-instruction exception is raised.

findings.finding: SEnvCfg extends EnvCfg with an empty body. SSE remains RO(3)=0. The senvcfg CSR has no SSE-related logic. Zicfiss is not implemented.

spec_citations.excerpt: Otherwise, if in U-mode and senvcfg[sse] is 0, an illegal-instruction exception is raised.

findings.finding: The decode table assembles XDecode, FpDecode, BitmanipDecode, ScalarCryptoDecode, CBODecode, SvinvalDecode, HypervisorDecode, VecDecoder, ZicondDecode, ZimopDecode, and ZfaDecode. There is no ZicfissDecode table. All Zicfiss instructions (sspush, sspopchk, ssrdp, c.sspush, c.sspopchk) fall through to Zimop no-op behavior or illegal-instruction decodeDefault. Zicfiss is not implemented.
findings.snippet:
val decode_table: Array[(BitPat, List[BitPat])] = XDecode.table ++
  FpDecode.table ++
  BitmanipDecode.table ++
  ScalarCryptoDecode.table ++
  XSDebugDecode.table ++
  CBODecode.table ++
  SvinvalDecode.table ++
  HypervisorDecode.table ++
  VecDecoder.table ++
  ZicondDecode.table ++
  ZimopDecode.table ++
  ZfaDecode.table

spec_citations.excerpt: The Zicfiss instructions, except ssamoswap.w and ssamoswap.d, are encoded using a subset of May-Be-Operation instructions defined by the Zimop and Zcmop extensions. This subset of instructions revert to their Zimop- or Zcmop-defined behavior when the Zicfiss extension is not implemented.

findings.finding: CSRConfig defines EXT_SSTC and EXT_DBLTRP flags but has no EXT_ZICFISS, EXT_SSE, or EXT_CFI configuration flag. Zicfiss is not implemented.
findings.snippet:
final val EXT_SSTC = true
final val EXT_DBLTRP = true

findings.finding: CSRToDecode defines illegalInst and virtualInst bundles for various extensions (sfenceVMA, hfenceGVMA, hfenceVVMA, hlsv, fsIsOff, vsIsOff, wfi, wrs_nto, frm, cboZ, cboCF, cboI) but has no SSE-related illegal-instruction or virtual-instruction signal. Zicfiss is not implemented.
